title: Create: Boot Enchants
description: Ever wanted to use any boots to walk on mechanical belts?
body:
Have you ever been using the diving boots to walk on mechanical belts but been incredibly annoyed when trying to swim in water and sinking? Ever wanted to walk on belts but with a pair of boots you like more?

Well I have just the thing for you! Create: Boot Enchants adds the enchantment "Belt Walker" which allows you to enchant any pair of boots to allow you to walk on belts, without sinking in water and lava!

Eventually I plan on adding another enchantment "Weighted Soles" to allow you to specifically sink in liquid and not walk on belts, you will be able to combine these enchantments to get the full effects of diving boots on any pair of boots you please!

I also plan on backporting to 1.20.1, and create fabric at some point.
